# U18: Set a goal for the year and its plan numbers by hand

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `PLAN-SHAPE`, `GOAL-CREATE`, `YEAR`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Mateo, at `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U18

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Mateo (`mateo`).
- Go to `/goals/new` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “Runbooks with an owner” into the “Name it the way” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- _Note:_ Mateo leads SRE, which owns north stars, so he is asked the level (OB1, rule 1).
- **Step.** Press the “Team” button in the “Level” group.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- _Note:_ To starts as the year's end and says so under the week picker (goal entry 2.4 and 2.13; GE9).
- _Note:_ To is the fourth field on a phone, so it is looked for, not expected above the fold.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “To Week N ·” button is visible (else: To isn’t on the measure step).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the “To Week N ·” button is visible and the part `.weekpick-is, .weekpick-is-inline` in the weekpick (`.weekpick`) showing “The end of N” is there (else: a new goal is not due at the year end by default).
- **Step.** Type “%” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Type “20” into the “Baseline” field.
- **Step.** Type “90” into the “Target” field.
- _Note:_ The plan is a table of numbers, with the shape's defaults, folded under the chart (OB1); type over one.
- **Step.** Press the words “Adjust the plan week by week”.
- **Check:** The “Plan for week N” field shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the plan table has no default numbers.
- **Step.** Type “30” into the “Plan for week N” field.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “plan table”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue” button.
- **Check:** “with the weeks’ numbers set by hand” is shown (else: the read-back says the plan was set by hand).
- **Step.** Press the “Publish goal” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/goal_”.
- _Note:_ About this goal is open on a first visit, with the plan week by week (the flagship page, 5 Nov).
- **Check:** “Plan and actual by week” is shown.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the year end or the hand-set number was not saved.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
